entries.title: Finding Identification
indirect_expressions: the reviewer infers finding_identification from context
false_positives: treating a comment as a finding
inflating confidence without support
counter_examples: A reviewer stays at observation when evidence is weak.
A reviewer requests context rather than overreading the line.
reviewer_guidance: Read the full scene before deciding.
Separate observation, comment, possible finding, and confirmed finding.
Collect every available evidence source before discarding a reading.
Treat the strongest traceable evidence as primary, not the first clue encountered.
Downgrade confidence when evidence is weak, conflicting, or incomplete.
When one finding supports multiple canonical atoms, keep every supported atom and choose the primary atom deterministically by semantic match, severity, and clarity.
Escalate only when confidence supports it.

entries.title: Evidence Collection
indirect_expressions: the reviewer infers evidence_collection from context
false_positives: treating a comment as a finding
inflating confidence without support
making the primary atom depend on article order instead of canonical atom evidence
treating weak context as if it were independent support
ignoring unresolved conflict between sources
counter_examples: A reviewer stays at observation when evidence is weak.
A reviewer requests context rather than overreading the line.
A reviewer waits for a second source before escalating a borderline cue.
reviewer_guidance: Read the full scene before deciding.
Separate observation, comment, possible finding, and confirmed finding.
Prefer corroborated evidence over a lone weak cue.
Weigh conflicting sources instead of counting them blindly.
Escalate only when confidence supports it.

entries.title: Evidence Prioritization
indirect_expressions: the reviewer infers evidence_prioritization from context
false_positives: treating a comment as a finding
inflating confidence without support
treating multiple weak clues as stronger than one explicit source
ignoring unresolved conflict between sources
counter_examples: A reviewer stays at observation when evidence is weak.
A reviewer requests context rather than overreading the line.
A reviewer downgrades a finding when corroboration disappears.
reviewer_guidance: Read the full scene before deciding.
Separate observation, comment, possible finding, and confirmed finding.
Collect both supporting and contradicting sources before finalizing a claim.
Treat missing support as insufficiency, not as proof of the opposite.
Escalate only when confidence supports it.

entries.title: Context Analysis
indirect_expressions: the reviewer infers context_analysis from context
false_positives: treating a comment as a finding
inflating confidence without support
calling insufficient evidence a contradiction
ignoring the strongest source because a weaker one appears earlier
treating quotation as endorsement
treating narration as the speaker's own statement
treating comedy or satire as automatic exemptions
counter_examples: A reviewer stays at observation when evidence is weak.
A reviewer requests context rather than overreading the line.
A reviewer waits for corroboration before committing to a conclusion.
A reviewer distinguishes narration from dialogue and scene description from direct speech.
reviewer_guidance: Read the full scene before deciding.
Separate observation, comment, possible finding, and confirmed finding.
Treat historical, educational, documentary, comedy, satire, dream, flashback, quotation, narration, and scene-description cues as framing signals, not automatic verdicts.
Historical context can still carry a flaggable meaning, while educational or protective framing may change the interpretation of the same words.
Escalate only when confidence supports it.
